en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a stone World War I memorial relief mounted on the exterior wall of a historic church. The relief is divided into arched sections with religious figures, soldiers, and mourners. Below it is an iron fence with panels listing many names and wreaths attached. To the right are the stone blocks of the church wall and adjacent townhouses with shuttered windows. A caption in German is printed in the lower right corner.
